title: 2012 AMC 8 Problem 4
statement: Peter’s family ordered a \(12\)-slice pizza for dinner. Peter ate one slice and shared another slice equally with his brother Paul. What fraction of the pizza did Peter eat?

solutions.text:
Peter ate \(1\) full slice, and he ate \(\dfrac 12 \) of the slice that he split.

Therefore, he ate \( \dfrac{\frac{3}{2}}{12} \) of the pizza, which is equivalent to \(\dfrac 18.\)

Thus, the answer is C .
hints: Peter ate one whole slice plus half of another slice.
Convert \(1+\frac{1}{2}\) slices into a fraction of \(12\) slices.
